changes.summary: Lens: the methodology formula chrome (panel.formula, .show, .error, .variables, .source, .version, .noValue) is translated in the built-in ru and uz catalogues; Linux visual baselines cover the formula and table-fit stories and the narrow-container table in the panel matrix.

Add Lens methodology formulas: optional LaTeX formula on measures and panels with per-calculation variable values, shared lazy KaTeX module, <lens-formula> element, print methodology block and Excel Methodology sheet.

Lens: a table level of an explorer returns and draws its footer total (QueryResponse.Summary, runtime.PanelResult.TableTotals / ApplyTableTotals); screen-reader labels (period steps, quality chips, export errors) are translated in the built-in ru and uz catalogues, and the SDK's English baseline no longer hides built-in translations for those locales (document.RuntimeI18nDefaultsFor); tables narrow and wrap to their container before they scroll.
